meals.name: Cajun crispy baked wings with honey-hot butter glaze
steps: Heat oven to 425°F with a rack on a foil-lined sheet. Pat 3 lb wings very dry and toss with 1 Tbsp baking powder, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1½ tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp dried thyme, ½ tsp cayenne, 1½ tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper.
Spread the wings on the rack in one layer. Bake 25 minutes, flip, and bake 20–25 minutes more until deeply crisp and 175°F at the thickest part (at least 165°F).
Meanwhile melt 3 Tbsp butter with 3 Tbsp honey, ⅓ cup hot sauce and 1 Tbsp lemon juice; simmer 1 minute.
Toss the hot wings in the glaze and serve with celery and baby carrots on the side.

meals.name: Slow-roasted Cuban mojo pork with onions over rice
steps: Mash 8 garlic cloves with 2 tsp salt; stir in the juice of 1 orange and 3 limes (about ¾ cup), 2 Tbsp olive oil, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp oregano and 1 tsp pepper. Rub all over a 4 lb bone-in pork shoulder; marinate at least 1 hour or overnight in the fridge.
Heat oven to 325°F. Slice 2 onions into a roasting pan, add 2 bay leaves and ½ cup water, set the pork on top and pour over the marinade. Cover tightly with foil.
Roast 3½–4 hours until fork-tender (well above 145°F, about 195°F to shred). Uncover for the last 30 minutes at 425°F to crisp the outside.
Cook 2 cups rice. Shred the pork, toss with the onions and pan juices, and serve over rice with chopped cilantro and lime wedges.

meals.name: Smoky sausage, sweet potato and pepper sheet pan with honey-mustard drizzle
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cut 2 lb sweet potatoes into ¾-inch cubes, 2 red peppers into strips and 1 onion into wedges. Toss with 2 Tbsp olive oil, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp thyme, ¼ tsp red pepper flakes, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper.
Roast on a large sheet pan 15 minutes. Meanwhile pinch 1 lb Italian sausage into walnut-size pieces.
Stir the vegetables, scatter the sausage on top and roast 15–18 minutes more until the sausage is browned and 160°F and the sweet potatoes are caramelized.
Whisk 2 Tbsp mustard, 1½ Tbsp honey and 1 Tbsp cider vinegar; drizzle over the pan right before serving.

meals.name: Chili-lime chicken burrito bowls with avocado and quick-pickled onions
steps: Quick-pickle: thinly slice ½ onion and cover with ½ cup vinegar, ½ cup hot water, 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp salt; let sit while you cook. Cook 1 cup rice and stir in the zest of 1 lime and a handful of chopped cilantro.
Toss 1½ lb chicken breast with 2 Tbsp oil, juice of 1 lime, 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp oregano and 1 tsp salt.
Sear the chicken in a hot skillet 5–7 minutes per side until 165°F; rest 5 minutes and slice. Warm 1 drained can of black beans with a pinch of cumin and salt.
Stir ½ cup sour cream with the juice of ½ lime. Build bowls with rice, beans, chicken, 2 sliced avocados, pickled onions and a drizzle of lime crema.

meals.name: Soy-garlic marinated London broil with charred broccoli and rice
steps: Whisk ¼ cup soy sauce, 2 Tbsp brown sugar, 1 Tbsp rice vinegar, 1 Tbsp sesame oil, 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp grated ginger (or ½ tsp ground) and ¼ tsp red pepper flakes. Marinate a 1½ lb London broil in it for 2–8 hours in the fridge.
Cook 1 cup rice. Heat the broiler with a rack about 4 inches from the heat. Broil the steak 5–7 minutes per side to 135°F for medium-rare (145°F for medium); rest 10 minutes.
Meanwhile toss 1½ lb broccoli florets with 1 Tbsp oil and a pinch of salt and broil or roast at 450°F 8–10 minutes until charred at the edges.
Boil the leftover marinade 2 minutes to make a sauce. Slice the steak thinly against the grain and serve over rice with the broccoli, sauce and sliced green onions.

meals.name: Smoky sweet potato and black bean enchiladas (meatless)
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Toss 2 lb diced sweet potatoes, 1 diced red pepper and 1 diced onion with 1 Tbsp oil, 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp salt; roast 25 minutes until tender.
Sauce: simmer 15 oz tomato sauce, ½ cup broth, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 Tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and ½ tsp oregano for 5 minutes.
Mash about a third of the roasted vegetables with 2 drained cans black beans, the juice of 1 lime and 1 cup shredded cheese; fold in the rest of the vegetables.

Lower oven to 375°F. Warm 12 corn tortillas, fill and roll them, and set seam-side down in a 9x13 dish over a little sauce. Top with the rest of the sauce and 1 cup cheese; bake 20 minutes until bubbling.

meals.name: Lemon-garlic shrimp scampi linguine with chili flakes
steps: Boil 1 lb linguine in well-salted water until al dente; save 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Pat 1 lb peeled shrimp dry and season with ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper. Sear in 2 Tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat 1–2 minutes per side until pink and 145°F; move to a plate.
Lower the heat, add 4 Tbsp butter, 6 sliced garlic cloves and ½ tsp red pepper flakes; cook 1 minute. Add ½ cup broth, the zest and juice of 1 lemon and simmer 2 minutes.
Toss in the pasta, shrimp, ¼ cup parmesan and splashes of pasta water until glossy. Finish with parsley or a pinch of Italian seasoning and more pepper.

meals.name: Jerk-spiced roast chicken thighs with coconut-lime rice
steps: Blend or whisk ½ onion (grated), 4 garlic cloves, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, 2 Tbsp brown sugar, 1 Tbsp oil, juice of 1 lime, 2 tsp allspice, 2 tsp dried thyme, ½ tsp cinnamon, ½ tsp cayenne (or 1 Tbsp hot sauce), 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Coat 2½ lb chicken thighs and marinate 1–12 hours.
Heat oven to 425°F. Roast the thighs skin-side up on a foil-lined pan 35–40 minutes until charred at the edges and 175°F (at least 165°F).
Meanwhile simmer 1 cup rice with ¾ cup coconut milk, 1 cup water and ½ tsp salt, covered, 18 minutes; rest 5 minutes and stir in the zest of 1 lime.
Serve the chicken over the coconut rice with pan juices, sliced green onions and lime wedges.

meals.name: Garlic-herb roast pork loin with mustard pan gravy and smashed potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Mix 5 minced garlic cloves, 2 Tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp each rosemary, thyme and smoked paprika, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper; rub over a 3 lb pork loin. Set it on 1 sliced onion in a roasting pan.

Roast 50–65 minutes until 145°F in the center; rest 10 minutes. Meanwhile boil 3 lb yellow potatoes until tender, 15 minutes; drain, smash on an oiled sheet pan, brush with 2 Tbsp melted butter and salt, and roast alongside 25 minutes until crisp.
Gravy: set the roasting pan over medium heat, add 1 Tbsp butter and 1½ Tbsp flour and cook 1 minute. Whisk in 1½ cups broth and 1 Tbsp Dijon; simmer 3–4 minutes until thick.
Slice the pork and serve with the crispy potatoes and mustard gravy.

meals.name: Philly-style sirloin cheesesteaks with jammy onions
steps: Freeze 1¼ lb sirloin 30 minutes, then slice paper-thin. Slice 2 onions and cook in 1 Tbsp oil and 1 Tbsp butter over medium heat with a pinch of salt, 15 minutes, until soft and golden.

Season the steak with ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Sear in batches in a very hot oiled skillet 1–2 minutes until browned and cooked through (145°F), chopping with a spatula; add 1 Tbsp Worcestershire.
Fold the onions into the steak, split into 4 piles, and top each with about 1½ oz thinly sliced cheese; cover 1 minute to melt.
Toast the split rolls, scoop each pile in and add hot sauce or pickled peppers if you like.
